# hyperping_on_call_schedules (Data Source)

Fetches the list of all Hyperping on-call schedules via MCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) List of on-call schedule UUIDs.
- `schedules` (Attributes List) List of on-call schedules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules))

<a id="nestedatt--schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules`

Read-Only:

- `current_oncall` (String) The name of the person currently on-call.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the schedule.
- `name` (String) The name of the schedule.
- `next_oncall` (String) The name of the person next on-call.
- `rotation_end` (String) End time of the current rotation.
- `rotation_start` (String) Start time of the current rotation.
- `team` (String) The team name this schedule belongs to.
